title: Antes
goal: Talk about your childhood and what used to happen, with the imperfect.

lessons.title: I used to play
lessons.notes:
The **imperfect** (imperfecto) looks at the past as a background or a habit: what you **used to** do, what was **going on**. It doesn't care when it started or ended.
For **-ar** verbs, drop -ar and add **-aba**:
**yo** jugaba · **tú** jugabas · **él / ella / usted** jugaba · **nosotros** jugábamos · **ellos / ustedes** jugaban
**yo** and **él** are the same form - add the pronoun or a name if it's unclear.
One English sentence, three choices: **jugaba** can be "I used to play", "I was playing" or just "I played" (as a habit).
**de niño / de niña** = as a child.

sentences.es: De niño jugaba al fútbol todos los días.
sentences.en: As a child I used to play football every day.
accept_en: As a child I played football every day.
As a kid I used to play soccer every day.
When I was a child I played football every day.

sentences.es: ¿Jugabas con tus hermanos?
sentences.en: Did you use to play with your brothers?
accept_en: Did you play with your brothers?
Did you use to play with your brothers and sisters?
Used you to play with your siblings?

sentences.es: Jugábamos en la calle después de la escuela.
sentences.en: We used to play in the street after school.
accept_en: We played in the street after school.
We would play in the street after school.

sentences.es: Mis primos jugaban en el parque.
sentences.en: My cousins used to play in the park.
accept_en: My cousins played in the park.
My cousins were playing in the park.

sentences.es: Antes trabajaba en un banco.
sentences.en: I used to work in a bank.
accept_en: Before, I worked in a bank.
I worked in a bank before.
I used to work at a bank.

sentences.es: Mi mamá cocinaba todos los días.
sentences.en: My mum used to cook every day.
accept_en: My mom used to cook every day.
My mother used to cook every day.

sentences.es: De niña jugaba con mi bicicleta en la calle.
sentences.en: As a girl I used to play with my bike in the street.
accept_en: As a child I played with my bicycle in the street.
As a girl I played with my bike in the street.
When I was little I used to play with my bike in the street.

sentences.es: Antes me levantaba tarde, ahora me levanto temprano.
sentences.en: I used to get up late, now I get up early.
accept_en: Before, I got up late; now I get up early.

sentences.es: Mis vecinos jugaban al fútbol con nosotros.
sentences.en: My neighbours used to play football with us.
accept_en: My neighbors used to play soccer with us.
My neighbours played football with us.

lessons.title: I used to have
lessons.notes:
**-er** and **-ir** verbs share one set of imperfect endings, all with an accent on the **í**:
**yo** tenía · **tú** tenías · **él / ella / usted** tenía · **nosotros** teníamos · **ellos / ustedes** tenían
No stem changes and almost no irregulars: **quería**, **podía**, **vivía**, **comía**, **hacía**.
The imperfect is also for what you **had**, **wanted** or **could** over a stretch of time - states rather than events:
**Tenía un perro.** = I had a dog (back then).
**Quería ser médico.** = I wanted to be a doctor.
Weather as background: **Hacía calor.** = It was hot.

sentences.es: De niño tenía un perro blanco.
sentences.en: As a child I had a white dog.
accept_en: As a kid I had a white dog.
When I was a child I had a white dog.

sentences.es: Vivía en un pueblo pequeño.
sentences.en: I lived in a small town.
accept_en: I used to live in a small town.
I lived in a small village.
I used to live in a little village.

sentences.es: Teníamos una casa en el barrio.
sentences.en: We had a house in the neighbourhood.
accept_en: We used to have a house in the neighbourhood.
We had a house in the neighborhood.

sentences.es: Quería ser médico.
sentences.en: I wanted to be a doctor.
accept_en: I used to want to be a doctor.

sentences.es: Antes comía mucho pan.
sentences.en: I used to eat a lot of bread.
accept_en: Before, I ate a lot of bread.
I ate a lot of bread before.

sentences.es: En mi pueblo siempre hacía calor.
sentences.en: In my town it was always hot.
accept_en: It was always hot in my town.
In my village it was always hot.

sentences.es: No podía dormir por la noche.
sentences.en: I couldn't sleep at night.
accept_en: I wasn't able to sleep at night.

sentences.es: Mis abuelos vivían cerca de la escuela.
sentences.en: My grandparents lived near the school.
accept_en: My grandparents used to live near the school.
My grandparents lived close to the school.

sentences.es: ¿Qué querías ser de niño?
sentences.en: What did you want to be as a child?
accept_en: What did you want to be when you were little?
What did you want to be as a kid?

lessons.title: It was, there was
lessons.notes:
Only three verbs are irregular in the imperfect:
**ser**: era · eras · era · éramos · eran
**ir**: iba · ibas · iba · íbamos · iban
**ver**: veía · veías · veía · veíamos · veían
And **hay** becomes **había** = there was / there were (one form for both, singular and plural):
**Había un parque.** · **Había muchos niños.**
**era** is for describing people, places and times in the past: **Era alto.** (He was tall.) **Eran las diez.** (It was ten o'clock.)
**Cuando era niño...** (When I was a child...) is how many childhood stories begin.

sentences.es: Cuando era niño, era muy tímido.
sentences.en: When I was a child, I was very shy.
accept_en: When I was a kid, I was very shy.
As a child I was very shy.

sentences.es: Mi abuela era muy simpática.
sentences.en: My grandmother was very nice.

sentences.es: Éramos cinco en mi familia.
sentences.en: There were five of us in my family.
accept_en: We were five in my family.

sentences.es: Los veranos eran muy largos.
sentences.en: The summers were very long.

sentences.es: Los domingos íbamos a la playa.
sentences.en: On Sundays we used to go to the beach.
accept_en: On Sundays we went to the beach.
We used to go to the beach on Sundays.

sentences.es: Iba a la escuela con mi hermano.
sentences.en: I used to go to school with my brother.
accept_en: I went to school with my brother.
I would go to school with my brother.

sentences.es: Veía dibujos animados todas las mañanas.
sentences.en: I used to watch cartoons every morning.

sentences.es: En mi barrio había un parque grande.
sentences.en: In my neighbourhood there was a big park.
accept_en: There was a big park in my neighbourhood.
In my neighborhood there was a big park.

sentences.es: Eran las diez de la noche.
sentences.en: It was ten o'clock at night.

lessons.title: How often?
lessons.notes:
The imperfect loves words of **repetition**, because it describes habits:
**siempre** (always) · **a menudo** (often) · **a veces** (sometimes) · **nunca** (never) · **cada** (each, every): **cada verano** · **todos los años** (every year)
**soler** + infinitive = to usually do: **solía ir** = I used to go. It's o -> ue in the present (**suelo**), but the imperfect **solía** is the form you'll use most for the past.
**mientras** (while) sets two actions side by side: **Mientras mi papá cocinaba, yo leía.**
Rule of thumb: if you could say "used to" or "would" in English, choose the imperfect.

accept_en: to be in the habit of

sentences.es: Íbamos a la playa a menudo.
sentences.en: We often went to the beach.
accept_en: We used to go to the beach often.
We would often go to the beach.

sentences.es: A veces jugaba con mis primos.
sentences.en: Sometimes I used to play with my cousins.
accept_en: Sometimes I played with my cousins.
I sometimes played with my cousins.

sentences.es: Cada verano visitábamos a mis abuelos.
sentences.en: Every summer we used to visit my grandparents.
accept_en: Every summer we visited my grandparents.
Each summer we visited my grandparents.

sentences.es: Todos los años hacíamos una fiesta.
sentences.en: Every year we used to have a party.
accept_en: Every year we had a party.
Every year we threw a party.
Every year we would have a party.

sentences.es: Solía leer antes de dormirme.
sentences.en: I used to read before falling asleep.
accept_en: I usually read before falling asleep.
I used to read before I fell asleep.

sentences.es: Mientras mi papá cocinaba, yo leía.
sentences.en: While my dad cooked, I read.
accept_en: While my dad was cooking, I was reading.
While my father cooked, I used to read.

sentences.es: Mi juguete favorito era una bicicleta roja.
sentences.en: My favourite toy was a red bicycle.
accept_en: My favorite toy was a red bike.
My favourite toy was a red bike.

sentences.es: Había un árbol muy alto en el jardín.
sentences.en: There was a very tall tree in the garden.
accept_en: There was a really tall tree in the garden.
In the garden there was a very tall tree.

sentences.es: Nunca comía fruta de niño.
sentences.en: I never used to eat fruit as a child.
accept_en: I never ate fruit as a child.
As a kid I never ate fruit.
